caption: The drawing depicts a suit consisting of a black tailcoat and matching black trousers, paired with a cream or off-white waistcoat and a similarly colored high-collared shirt. The tailcoat features a double-breasted design with two rows of three black buttons and long, slightly tapered sleeves with turned-back cuffs. The waistcoat underneath is lighter in color and is fastened with small buttons, functioning as a visible garment under the open tailcoat. The shirt collar is tall, encircling the neck, and is complemented by a bow tie or cravat of the same light color. There is no visible head, hands, or feet in the drawing, and the background is a plain, off-white color without any additional objects or details. The illustration uses shading to convey the texture and folds of the fabric, emphasizing the formal style of the clothing.
title: Man's Suit
